data.content:

I had to read the game, try to position myself well on the pitch and, luckily, I didn't find it too difficult," he explained at the time, before summing up what that week meant to him: "It was always my dream to play for Estudiantes." Since then, he has won four trophies with 'El Pincha': the 2023 Copa Argentina, the 2024 and 2025 Trofeo de Campeones titles, and the 2025 Torneo Clausura. The showdown on 28 November will be his eighth final with the club and his [...] Estudiantes returned to the CONMEBOL Libertadores as champions of Argentina's Torneo Clausura, with Benedetti once again a regular starter, featuring in the starting line-up in nine of their 12 matches. Their campaign brought a reunion with Flamengo in Group A, which saw a 1-1 draw in La Plata and a 1-0 defeat at the Maracanã. Qualification was only secured on the final matchday, courtesy of Mikel Amondarain's goal against Independiente Medellín. Next came a 3-0 victory over Universidad [...] The left-back scored the only goal in a 1-0 victory over Flamengo in the second leg of the 2025 quarter-finals, but had his penalty saved by Agustín Rossi in the shootout that eliminated 'El Pincha'.
 Having started nine of Estudiantes' 12 matches in the 2026 CONMEBOL Libertadores, he heads to Montevideo for his first international final.
